_comment: The generate binding for `npm run eval`. Copy to cli.json and customise. The runner writes the system prompt to {{system_prompt_file}} and the user message to {{user_message_file}}, then spawns cmd with the rendered args. stdout is captured, parsed as JSON, and extract_path (dotted) selects the model's actual text response before that text is JSON-parsed by the runner. Set extract_path to null if the CLI emits the model response directly as plain JSON on stdout. Set retries to N to allow up to N additional attempts (total = 1 + N) on CLI exit, timeout, non-JSON stdout, extract_path miss or a generated blueprint that fails its schema; each attempt writes its own logs when retries > 0. The judges are not bound here: they use the blueprint-judge binding in evaluation/config.json.

generate.description: Invokes an LLM CLI to produce a Blueprint V2 from a story brief. Receives the generator-prompt.md as system and the brief-wrapped user message as input.
